text:
Maya (CS): Heads up — we need a lightweight QBR "landing pad" for Meridia before Tues exec readout. One slide deck, +1 page of activation plays we can hand to the execs. Can folks flag must-haves?

Ravi (Product): +1. I'll own the performance snapshot. Need the onboarding status and top 3 friction points from CS.

Lina (CS Ops): I'll pull the onboarding cohort metrics tonight (activation %, time-to-first-success, outstanding tasks). ETA: 10pm PT. Anything else to include?

Samir (AM): Renewal signal: Meridia is at medium risk — usage dipping in 2 of 3 teams. I'll add the renewal timeline and negotiation ask. Need callouts for any blockers that would change our recommendation.

Nora (SE): I can record a 90s demo clip of the new onboarding template to drop into the deck. Loom link when ready. Also have one technical risk: their SSO rollout has a known edge-case (multi-tenant mapping). Alerted infra.

Maya (CS): Perfect. For the landing pad lets keep this structure: 
```
Slide A: Executive snapshot (health + renewal flag)
Slide B: Activation plays (3 prioritized actions)
Slide C: Onboarding gaps & timelines
Slide D: Cost/usage trend + ask (if any)
Appendix: Demo clip + infra risk notes
```

Lina (CS Ops): Quick note — cohort data shows 42% activation vs target 65. Biggest drop at step 3 (policy import). I'll attach the table.

Samir (AM): Action item: I'll send the renewal ask matrix and the preferred concession ranges by EOD.

Ravi (Product): Can we standardize the activation plays language? Say: "1) Rapid policy import workshop (1 hr) — owner: SE, 2) Live coaching for champions (2 sessions) — owner: CS, 3) Config health check (automated) — owner: Product Ops". Ping if you want tweaks.

Maya (CS): Love it. Owners: Nora for workshop, Lina for coaching logistics, Ravi for health check. Samir will own exec ask slide. I'll compile deck and send initial draft by 9am tomorrow.

Nora (SE): Loom done: https://loom.com/share/abcd-90s-demo. Also uploaded a short notes doc on the SSO edge-case.

Lina (CS Ops): Uploaded cohort table to the QBR folder: /qbr/meridia/cohort-table.csv. Added a small chart: activation by step.

Samir (AM): FYI — sales ops confirmed expected renewal date: 2026-05-15. Marking as high-priority for exec ask.

Maya (CS): Two quick asks before I build: (1) Any exec-level one-liners (impact/ask)? (2) Any customer quotes or NPS snippets we should include?

Ravi (Product): Exec one-liner: "Meridia shows strong optimization outcomes when policies fully onboarded — top customers see 3–4x faster inference pipeline time; our 3 plays will close the 23% activation gap."

Samir (AM): I'll pull last NPS comment — include the line about "support responsiveness" (positive).

Loom-bot: New recording uploaded by Nora — 90s demo (ID: 5260001248).

Maya (CS): Final action list (copying here):
- Maya: Compile deck + slide notes (due: tomorrow 9am)
- Lina: Final cohort table + step chart (due: tonight 10pm)
- Nora: Run workshop demo clip + SSO note (done)
- Ravi: Perf snapshot + health-check recommendation (due: tomorrow 7am)
- Samir: Renewal ask matrix + NPS quote (due: tonight 11pm)

Maya (CS): If everyone is good with owners/times I'll schedule a 20-min runthrough tomorrow at 11am PT. Say :thumbsup: if works or suggest alternate.

Ravi (Product): :thumbsup:

Lina (CS Ops): :thumbsup: on time

Samir (AM): :thumbsup: can do 11am

Nora (SE): :thumbsup: will be there

Maya (CS): Great — thanks all. I'll post the draft in #qbr-review when ready.
